Best Hiking Boots of 2026

We tested twelve pairs over three hundred miles of trail. The Ridgeline Pro was the most comfortable out of the box, the Granite GTX kept feet driest in creek crossings, and the Summit Lite was the lightest pair we tried at just under two pounds.

For most hikers we recommend the Ridgeline Pro. It costs more than the others but the cushioning held up after every test, and the lacing system stayed tight on long descents.
